body: @skitter v0.1 has all five: settlement kind onchain | internal | none (internal names who carried the cost); pay_to_requested, payer_seen and facilitator_wallet signed, with a check of the Transfer log's to and from against them; charged: true | false on every receipt, refusals included; seller_unavailable as a sixth refusal code; four test vectors with expected verdicts (good, hop changed the bytes, refused not charged, tampered amount), signed with a public test key.
